To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
AB 5 -type alloys with Mm as the A component and Mn, Co, Cu, Al or mixtures of them as the B component were synthesized by mechanical milling.
The electrochemical capacities of AB5-type compounds prepared by mechanical milling are strongly influenced by the surface state and the internal strain of the sample.

(i) mechanical alloying is a very useful tool to synthesize AB5-type hy-dride-forming compounds; (ii) these compounds are able to absorb large amounts of hydrogen and can be used as hydrogen storage materials; and (iii) the electrochemical capacity of these materials can be enhanced by a post-an-nealing step.

the electrochemical properties of hydride forming materials synthesized by mechanical alloy.
